record.dic_text:
01106 Bela` {be'-la}

與 01105 同; 

欽定本 - Bela 13, Belah 1; 14

比拉 = "破壞"
陽性專有名詞 人名
1) 以東的一個王 (#代上 1:43|)
2) 便雅憫的第一個兒子
3) 流便人亞撒的兒子 (#代上 5:8|)

專有名詞 地名
4) 羅得選擇的約旦河全平原的五個城市之一, 也叫瑣珥 (#創 14:2,8|)
record.edic_text:
01106 Bela` {beh'-lah}

the same as 01105;;

AV - Bela 13, Belah 1; 14

Bela = "destruction"
n pr m
1) a king of Edom
2) first son of Benjamin
3) a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite
n pr loc
4) one of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the
   intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar
